I am writing to express my interest in the Senior Platform Engineer position at Tideline Freight. With six years of experience as a backend engineer at Northwind Robotics, where I owned the order-routing service built on TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL handling approximately 2 million events per day, I have developed a strong foundation in building and operating large-scale systems. Additionally, I spent two years as an engineering lead at Vertex Logistics, where I led a team of five across dispatch and billing product lines, honing my ability to guide technical projects and teams.

One of my key achievements was migrating a monolithic system to event-driven services with zero customer-visible downtime. This nine-month strangler-fig migration reduced p99 checkout latency from 1.9 seconds to 340 milliseconds. I am also experienced with Kubernetes and Terraform for service deployment, and have deep expertise in PostgreSQL, including schema design, query tuning, and logical replication. These skills align well with the responsibilities of a platform engineer, ensuring reliable and scalable infrastructure.

I am eager to bring my technical expertise and leadership experience to Tideline Freight. My background in backend engineering, combined with my proven ability to lead teams and execute complex migrations, positions me to contribute effectively to your platform engineering efforts. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills can support your team's goals.
